It is recommended to use an accelerator. [/p][p][/p][p]Situation 2: When clicking the "Start Game" button, a login failure pop-up appears.[/p][p]Cause and Solution: This situation occurs because the accelerator proxy or network restrictions prevent the SDK from connecting. Game loading exception:[/p][p]Situation: After starting the game, the progress bar updates to the end, but the login page cannot be accessed.[/p][p]Cause: This situation is due to insufficient space on the C drive or permission restrictions preventing writing.[/p][p]Solution: You can clear disk space or manually create the directory C:/Users/lalala/AppData/LocalLow/Unity/ and then restart the computer. [/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any problems, you can send the problem description, your account information and a screenshot of the issue to the customer service email: 3940725824@qq.com[/p]

notes.title: 真明末真抗清！投资人想说的话！
notes.notes: [p]懂历史，尊敬民族英雄，不抗清，一个人最多只能达成其中两条，有些事儿，诸位心中自可明鉴。[/p][p]到底是所谓的羽化病更狠，还是清军的屠刀更恶，相信玩家心中自有公论。[/p][p]明明在1647年，就有豪格带领清军入川的事，为什么你游却一点没有体现？难道是羽化病只精准针对无辜的百姓、英雄的起义军、君王死社稷的崇祯皇帝和千年前的英雄赵云？你游设定说清兵提前撤走了，好一个春秋笔法！[/p][p]不论是从华夏史观还是民族史观，都不至于此，我想破了脑袋也想不通你游是什么史观？[/p][p]这很难不让人质疑你游是在挂羊头卖狗肉，此明末非彼明末，将来莫不是还要有扬州十胜，嘉定三捷做DLC？[/p][p]什么是真正的明末？[/p][p]是江南九不存一，是湖广填四川。[/p][p]是神州陆沉，断我华夏风骨。[/p][p]更是有一帮华夏儿女为了后世子孙能不系上那金钱鼠尾而浴血奋战，明知不可为而为之。[/p][p]拯生民于涂炭，复汉官之威仪。[/p][p]逐胡虏，除暴乱，使民皆得其所，雪中国之耻。[/p][p]他们的名字是李定国，是郑成功，是张煌言，是刘文秀，是孙承宗，是卢象升，是冯双礼，是曹变蛟，是陈上川，是……[/p][p]昔年明太祖曾言，山河焉有中华地，日月重开大统天。[/p][p]盖我中国之民，天必命我中国之人以安之，夷狄何得而治哉！[/p][p]为什么将近400年过去了，大家还是希望那时的人们再赢一次，不就是因为这正是无数人心中的意难平。[/p][p]其实我们都知道，真正的历史上，是天意难违，是含恨至死，华夏大地以一种悲壮的方式落下帷幕，如今种种都不过是后人的执念罢了。[/p][p]所幸，敌人的屠刀可以让百姓留发不留头，却留不住历史的轮转，纵使河山沉沦，但这些英雄事迹，并没有被人遗忘，而是在史册里，在人心里，并在三百多年后，再一次激励后人，迸发出了驱除鞑虏、恢复中华的振臂高呼！[/p][p]日月山河还在，汉家天下永在。[/p][p]就让我们，做那先行者，唤起更多的同路人，为后来者开山！[/p][p]在此，我陈旻郑重承诺，《明末：伐定天下》的所有收入都将完全可公示地投入DLC以及下一部作品《绍宋》的制作当中。[/p]

notes.title: 《Conquer the world》Q&A
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you all for your support of "Conquer the world". Here, Xiaojie will answer your questions.

Q: What is trust value? What is affection level?

A: Trust value is a character's numerical value in the "Story" mode, which changes based on your choices. The maximum trust value is 100. Each of the six female leads has a trust value. Reaching a specific trust value can unlock side quests or hidden endings. You can change the trust value by replaying the story.

Affection level is a character's numerical value in the "Date" mode. It increases by giving gifts (gifts can be obtained in the story and from the store). The affection level only increases and never decreases. Reaching a specific affection level can unlock exclusive date storylines. 

Q: What's the situation with in-game purchases and gacha? Can I play the game normally without spending money or gacha?
A: We do not force players to make in-game purchases. Not making any purchases will not affect your gaming experience. Players can obtain silver coins through plot rewinding and working at the Tianxiang Pavilion to buy items in the store and unlock game content. To prove that we can enjoy the game content without in-app purchases, we will disable the in-app purchase function. 

Q: Why aren't some hairstyles rat-tails like the ones of the money rats?
A: This hairstyle requires the actors to shave their heads. We have done everything possible to get the actors to cooperate, but due to the limited number of actors, there will be a mix of hairstyles. 

Strict Statement

This game can be fully unlocked with all routes and endings without any recharge or in-game purchase. Stuck levels and bad endings occur due to route selection issues, as well as not discovering ways to earn silver by working at Tianxiang Pavilion, purchasing items, weapons, and equipment to enhance combat power, etc. Different routes and levels in the game are designed based on historical facts and the original work, aiming to showcase the indomitable spirit of the heroic ancestors who rose up to fight in the perilous and adverse circumstances of the late Ming Dynasty. There are no artificial consumption barriers set up. As the announcement failed to effectively guide and explain to many users that they can still have a normal gaming experience without making in-app purchases, we have no choice but to take drastic measures to prove our point. We will disable the in-app purchase function to show our sincerity![/p]

notes.title: "Conquer the world" Officially Announced Release Date
notes.notes:
[p]\[Classic IP Masterpiece, Live-Action Interactive Performance][/p][p]"Conquer the world" is an officially licensed adaptation of the original IP, and the first interactive film-game of historical military themes across the entire network. The official trailer of "Conquer the world" is released simultaneously. First-person immersive interaction and genuine scenes with heartfelt performances. 

Immerse yourself in history and feel the righteousness of the nation and family. The long river of history flows on, and you can join hands with your beloved and brothers, facing the surging torrent together. Will you establish your own kingdom and become a king, or will you turn the tide and support the emperor? With a single thought, you can be on the battlefield, experiencing that unforgettable history. 

【Hidden Exploration, Rich Gameplay Experience】
Within the story, follow the plot progression to uncover nearly a hundred different endings; explore hidden treasure chests, collect military weapons, and earn a reputation on the battlefield. Beyond the story, date and interact with six unique female characters to unlock stories exclusively yours; take orders at Tianxiang Pavilion to unlock interesting daily activities. 

【Launch Day Special Offer - Limited Time Discount】
After the official launch on July 17th, an 80% off special offer will be available for 14 days. During this period, many activities will be launched, including continuous giveaways of the full set of signed photos by the main creators and TO signs! 

Let's meet on July 17th. The door of history is about to open for all of you. Will you die for your name to be remembered or fade away in a foreign land? Save the collapsing situation and support the tottering building![/p][p][/p]
